source_description: Matched 04465 V1 firmware and board data from the supplied NON-HLOS image, with the unmodified RegDB 44.2 generated by the BSP regulatory workbook. The RegDB source revision is recorded separately below.

board_data.previous_active_source: 01651 BSP / ASUS modem bdwlan.e47, verified by device readback
board_data.selection: Install the matching 04465 BDF in /vendor/firmware so the kernel direct loader selects it before the old modem fallback.
board_data.reason: The new firmware interprets NV section 21 as 6 GHz CTL tables; the old 01651 BDF uses that section for an embedded regulatory database.

compatibility.silicon: QCA6490 V1; use amss.bin, not amss20.bin
compatibility.pairing_required: Use the 04465 amss, M3, board data and RegDB together; do not combine this database with 01722 firmware.
compatibility.host_configuration: Kernel regulatory tables must recognize FCC17_FCCA (0xE9) and classify FCC17 as FCC. Existing cnss-daemon and Wi-Fi configuration are retained.

tw.2g_5g: Unmodified RegDB 44.2 rules, including 5 GHz bandwidth up to 160 MHz. The earlier custom1 exception is not included.
tw.6g: LPI and VLP AP/client rules for 5945-6425 MHz, with a maximum bandwidth of 160 MHz and separate EIRP/PSD limits. Standard-power AP is disabled; runtime availability also depends on firmware, host policy and country selection.

validation.previous_39_0_runtime: The matched 04465 bundle booted, completed calibration, selected TW and connected as a 5 GHz 160 MHz station. This does not validate RegDB 44.2 or 6 GHz SoftAP.

next_stage: Validate boot stability, TW country selection, 5 GHz 160 MHz and 6 GHz station/SoftAP operation with this exact bundle and the FCC17 host mapping.

regdb.bin.source_description: Unmodified BSP regulatory workbook 44.2 output; not the packaged 39.0 in the supplied NON-HLOS image.
